title: AE+CSM weekly sync — NovaRetail & pilot accounts (scratchpad)
content:
Meeting context:
- Meeting: quick AE (Riley) + CSM (Jordan) weekly sync, 30m. Goal: align on NovaRetail renewal motion, unblock pilot ramp for AtlasHealth, and prioritize infra fixes affecting latency.
- Prep note: bring clear asks for Riley (sales) and map to engineering tickets where possible.

Top customers to touch this week (prioritized):
1) NovaRetail (Top 5 ARR, renewal in Q2) — current risk status: yellow
   - Health signals: stable call volume but 12% drop in active sessions last 14 days. Token cost per session up 18% due to longer prompts (cart summarization). Latency SLO violations last 3 days: p95 spiked to ~420ms on peak.
   - Open asks: Dedicated commitment pricing conversation (Riley lead), request for SLA language for latency (legal/comms), performance tuning (CS/SE + infra).
   - Blockers: INF-5123 (KV cache thrash under concurrent sessions) currently in triage; SE Samir thinks patch ready but needs canary validation.
   - Proposed quick wins to discuss in 1:1: push Atlas-quantized model variant to NovaRetail test route for cost reduction; schedule 1-hr performance walkthrough with their infra team (JP + DevOps).

2) AtlasHealth (pilot, HIPAA scope) — green/amber depending on VPC timeline
   - Pilot KPI: 50k tokens/day target, currently at 12k/day. Main constraint: VPC onboarding paperwork and HSM/KMS mapping.
   - Ask: confirm whether Private on-prem evaluation slot is needed or VPC with dedicated capacity suffices. Riley to reconfirm how far they are willing to move on contract.
   - Linked artifact: pilot runbook draft in Confluence (link above).

Agenda (30m):
- 00:00–00:05 quick status (Riley) — top asks from sales pipeline this week.
- 00:05–00:12 NovaRetail specifics: renewal timeline, pricing ask, risk mitigation plan.
- 00:12–00:20 AtlasHealth pilot gating items: VPC timeline, compliance checkpoints, SE support needed.
- 00:20–00:26 Infra blockers: INF-5123 & perf canary plan (Samir to update).
- 00:26–00:30 Quick action alignment and next check-in date.

Questions I want Riley to answer (prep to ask):
- Where is NovaRetail in procurement? Any change in procurement contact or timeline?
- If we propose a 6–9 month reserved capacity pilot (discounted), would that unlock faster commitment?
- For AtlasHealth, do they require on-prem or are they open to VPC + Dedicated? Any legal sign-off blockers we should escalate?

Notes to self (scratchy):
- Keep ask concrete: "we can offer N% off on 6mo reserved if you sign by mm/dd" — ask Riley for negotiating boundary.
- Do not promise infra ETA — offer canary window and rollback plan instead.
- Bring data: token trend chart, p95 latency chart for NovaRetail last 30d (grab from console before meeting).

Action items (clear, owner, due):
- Jordan: Pull token cost trend + p95 latency chart for NovaRetail; attach to meeting notes. Due: 2026-03-13.
- Riley: Confirm procurement SLA owner at NovaRetail and whether they will accept service-level language; propose negotiation threshold for discounts. Due: 2026-03-15.
- Samir (SE): Validate INF-5123 patch in staging and prepare quick canary rollout plan (steps + rollback). Due: 2026-03-14.
- Jordan + Samir: Draft customer-facing note to NovaRetail with proposed perf test window and cost estimate for quantized variant. Due: 2026-03-16.
- Riley: Ask legal to prepare optional SLA addendum template we can present. Due: 2026-03-19.
- Jordan: Follow-up with AtlasHealth contact (Dr. Li) to clarify VPC vs on-prem preference and share pilot runbook. Use email draft below. Due: 2026-03-14.

Email draft — AtlasHealth follow-up (quick send after meeting):
Subject: Next steps for AtlasHealth pilot — VPC / Dedicated options\nHi Dr. Li,\n\nThanks again for the pilot kickoff. Quick summary of next steps we discussed and a couple questions that will help us finalize the onboarding plan:\n\n1) VPC vs on-prem: can you confirm whether your security team prefers an on-prem deployment or if a VPC with our Dedicated offering (customer-managed VPC + KMS integration) is acceptable?\n2) Tokens & throughput: we estimate need for ~50k tokens/day at steady state; if you can share a target daily peak we can size a Dedicated pool for the pilot.\n3) Paperwork: we shared the HIPAA addendum — any missing signatures or legal questions we should route to our legal lead (Maya Ortiz)?\n\nIf it's helpful, happy to schedule a 30-minute call this week to walk the runbook and decide deployment mode.\n\nBest,\nJordan

Risks & flags to highlight in meeting:
- NovaRetail renewal: 30–45 day risk if we do not propose a concrete cost + performance path. Keep pressure to get procurement contact.
- INF-5123 may cause more p95 regressions if not canaried properly; avoid wide blast radius.

Loose notes / brainstorming (for follow-up doc):
- Consider offering a 3-month "performance pilot" (discounted reserved capacity) to prove p95 improvement before asking for full commitment. Could be a low-friction step to reduce buyer anxiety.
- Quick A/B experiment: route 10% of NovaRetail traffic to quantized model during off-peak window and measure latency/cost delta. If positive, propose staged rollout.

Outstanding asks I need to complete before next 1:1:
- Fetch NovaRetail procurement contact from CRM (SFDC note might be out of date).
- Confirm whether legal template is pre-approved for small customers or needs tailored language.
- Prepare 10–15 minute perf demo script for customer meeting (slides + demo checklist).

End of scratchpad.
